blueprint.context: The hinge of the chapter. Six people are offered the chance to break the thread and every one of them declines on grounds that are, individually, entirely sensible: the seals are single-strike, a College seal is not the Wardenry's to break, it isn't water, it isn't cargo, it isn't theirs. Denet checks Ysoly's water arithmetic in the margin of her own way-bill, which is the first thing about him that does not fit a passenger.
objectives: Deliver Sabra Onn's dawn ration call in full, in the eleven words she has used for thirty years
Bring the sealed survey packet aboard and establish exactly why it cannot be opened twice
Have every person present refuse to open it, in character and for a different reason each
Show Pell go silent mid-joke, which is the only warning anyone ever gets
Use Denet's tell -- checking arithmetic in the margin -- to mark him as more than a passenger

setting.description: The Tamm Line's yard at Bell Harrow in the last of the dark on departure morning. Forty-one hask husking the night's salt out of their nostrils, lanterns held low, the way-bill and a lamp on the tailgate of the fourth wagon.

synopsis: Departure morning. Sabra calls the ration figure to the yard before anyone can ask for it. Denet Rasca arrives with a College-sealed glass and a hide packet stitched shut under two single-strike seals, and refuses to open it. So does everyone else, each for their own reason. It is weighed at a pound and thirteen ounces and entered on the way-bill as passenger's goods.
title: The Sealed Thing
